rules.action: Moves to the next enabled option (and selects it when selection follows focus).
Moves to the previous enabled option.
Selects the focused option; with `multiple`, toggles it.
Selects the focused option (single) — inside a Select or Combobox, also closes the popup.
Multiple: moves and adds the next/previous option to the selection (add only; an already-selected option stays selected).
Multiple: selects all enabled options; pressed again when every enabled option is selected, deselects the enabled options. Selected disabled options stay selected either way.

Typeahead to the next option whose label starts with the typed characters; typing the same character repeatedly cycles through the options starting with it (APG) — a buffer of one letter repeated collapses back to that single letter and searches from the option after the active one, while any other buffer is a prefix searched from the active one. The buffer clears after `typeaheadReset`.

Moves by the `maxVisible` count of enabled options — not of drawn rows, so disabled rows and group labels do not consume the move — clamped to the last/first enabled option; with `maxVisible: all` jumps to the last/first enabled option. Follows `selectionFollowsFocus` like the arrows.
